title: PyFy Telemetry: F1 Performance Analysis Demo
description: Interactive demo of PyFy Telemetry - F1 Performance Analysis for EA Sports F1 25 and the 2026 Season Pack (F1 26 DLC): one race against the track's reference lap, corner by corner, before you install.
guide_description: How to install, capture telemetry, generate analysis charts against the track's reference lap, review CSV output, and prepare an AI coaching request with PyFy Telemetry F1.
csv_format_description: The CSV output format of PyFy Telemetry F1: every column of the per-lap and per-turn telemetry files, what it measures, its unit and how it is derived.
